claims.claim: GraphQL is the only macOS UI data plane for workflow truth: queries, subscriptions, and polling only. No GraphQL mutations.
P031-owned UI is strictly read-only. No MCP usage, no GraphQL mutations, no local workflow writes. MCP remains for agents, CLI, automation, and debug outside the UI.
r8/r9 operator correction materially changes P031 from a GraphQL+MCP thin-client control cutover into a GraphQL-only read/inspection cutover. This is not an incremental refinement of r7.
Create Idea, Start Run, Cancel Run, Stage Retry, Steward, runtime-health, session, clone, compare, and experiment write controls are removed or disabled from P031-owned screens.

Approval decision controls are the only surviving approval-related controls. They must not use UI MCP or GraphQL mutation. Absent a separately approved transport, they render disabled/read-only with Copy Diagnostic ID.

Static guards fail the P031 gate if P031-owned UI imports MCP, defines/executes GraphQL mutations, calls local recovery/execution mutations, constructs MCP parameter dictionaries, or creates ActionInvocationIdentity payloads.

Server read metadata exposes disabledReasonCode, payloadAvailabilityState, payloadUnavailableReasonCode, diagnosticId, and optional serverDebugDetail. No executable command fields (commandToolName, identity payloads, MCP parameters, journal/receipt fields) in P031 UI read models.

Swift thin-client boundary has 7 allowed types (WorkflowGraphQLReadClient, WorkflowGraphQLSubscriptionClient, WorkflowProjectionStore, WorkflowFreshnessReducer, DisabledReasonPresenter, PayloadUnavailableReasonPresenter, ThinUIAuthContext) and 5 explicitly forbidden type categories.
Read refresh is a targeted GraphQL refetch with active visual feedback. It cannot execute MCP, GraphQL mutation, or local mutation. r7 Check Status/command recovery is superseded.
Refreshing and projection_lag share one Syncing visual pattern with a reserved fixed-width slot after StatusCapsule. No per-field spinners, no layout shift.
Reports list rows show payloadAvailabilityState before drill-in: Payload available, Metadata only, Payload deferred, Generating, or Unavailable.
CommandStatusCapsule is removed from P031 after the GraphQL-only correction. Remaining indicators use state-specific VoiceOver labels.
Report metadata inspection is the P031 report deliverable. Full payload rendering is deferred to P031-FOLLOWUP-REPORT-PAYLOAD.
Three rollout modes: legacy, thin-read, dogfood. thin-command mode is removed by the GraphQL-only correction.
Phase 0 has four sub-checkpoints (0a-0d). Total effort estimate: 8.5-15 implementation days across all phases.
Dogfood population: 1-3 internal operators, same workflow family, two runs, with four scaling triggers for additional evidence.
Legacy expiry: 10 business days after flag removal with written release-owner extension for exceptional gaps.
Rollback drill result or release-owner waiver required before dogfood evidence acceptance.
Run-local r9 artifact is the governing implementation contract until synchronized to the checked-in proposal path.
Prerequisites: P027, P041, P042, P043. P029 is no longer listed (MCP auth not needed for GraphQL-only UI).
Three follow-ups: P031-FOLLOWUP-REPORT-PAYLOAD, P031-FOLLOWUP-APPROVAL-WRITE-PATH, P031-FOLLOWUP-UI-CONTROL-SURFACE.

13 metrics covering read ownership, projection correctness, UI MCP usage (0), GraphQL mutation usage (0), removed write controls (0), local truth bypasses (0), unsafe freshness, GraphQL freshness baseline, targeted read-refresh feedback, report payload visibility, time to Runs Home (2s/95%), Syncing stability, and disabled reason accessibility.
